name: learning-coach
description: Learn, inspect, prioritize, and maintain a private GitHub-backed learning state with auditable mastery evidence and durable coaching context.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, inspect, prioritize, and maintain a private knowledge tree
interface.longDescription: Learn through practice with auditable mastery evidence, inspect progress through Learning View, decide what to learn or review next through Ask Coach with a dedicated durable advisory-memory domain, and periodically maintain a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.
defaultPrompt: Help me master agent memory and resume from my Learning Vault.
Show my current learning state without changing my Learning Vault.
Based on my Learning Vault, tell me what I should learn, review, practice, connect, defer, or explore next.
Recommend whether I should open a new Topic, remember durable candidate Topics when useful, and explain what they connect to.
Review my Learning Vault for structural issues and propose safe refactors.
